intro.text_02: Flexible senior finance support for management reporting, FP&A, profitability analysis, forecasts, cash flow and financial control. No full-time finance hire required.

deliverables.text_02: Practical reporting and commercial analysis with agreed outputs and timing.
deliverables.text_03: Monthly P&L and KPI reports, variance explanations, performance trends and management actions.
deliverables.text_04: Operating budgets, forecasts, financial models, driver sensitivities and scenario planning.
deliverables.text_05: Client, project and product margins, cost drivers, contribution analysis and pricing support.
deliverables.text_06: Working capital forecasting, balance sheet review, reconciliations and month-end improvements.

finance_support.text_02: Regular or project-based finance support for owners and existing finance teams.
finance_support.text_03: Produce management KPIs, P&L analysis and clear explanations.
finance_support.text_04: Translate assumptions into budgets, cash flow and scenarios.
finance_support.text_05: Identify margin leakage, working capital issues and actions.
finance_support.text_07: Practical controllership and commercial analysis with clear deliverables.
finance_support.item_04: Cash flow, working capital and balance sheet reviews
finance_support.item_06: Scheduled month-end close and finance sparring
finance_support.text_08: €110/hour, agreed retainer or defined project. No urgent or full-time operational CFO coverage.

technical_accounting.text_02: Specialist, project-based IFRS and Dutch GAAP advice for complex transactions and reporting requirements. From Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS conversions to technical accounting papers, we agree the scope, deliverables and fee upfront.
technical_accounting.item_01: IFRS and Dutch GAAP assessments for revenue recognition, leases, provisions and complex contracts
technical_accounting.item_02: Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS conversions: gap analyses, opening balances, adjustment journals and comparatives
technical_accounting.item_03: Accounting implications of acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, goodwill and consolidation
technical_accounting.item_04: Technical accounting position papers, policy and disclosure reviews, and local-to-group reporting schedules

contact.heading_01: Need clearer financial reporting or stronger analysis?
contact.text_01: We agree the commercial question, deliverables and timetable before starting. For IFRS conversions or accounting standards advice, see our separate Technical Accounting service.

seo.title: Business Finance Advisory, FP&A & Profitability | Tellen Finance
seo.description: Management reporting, financial control, budgeting, forecasting, profitability and margin analysis for Dutch businesses. Flexible finance support at €110/hour.
